terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Trip helps people structure, record and share travel itineraries.
terms.service: You must provide accurate account information and respect other people using the service.
terms.account: You are responsible for protecting your account and password and for activity performed through your account.
terms.content: You keep ownership of itineraries and posts you create. You grant Trip permission to display that content as needed to operate the service.
terms.moderation: Content that is illegal, infringes rights or disrupts the service may be hidden or removed without prior notice.
terms.changes: When the service or these terms change, the new version will be posted here. Important changes will be announced in the service.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Trip processes the minimum personal information needed to provide the service.
privacy.collected: At sign-up we collect your email, username and password hash. We also store itineraries, posts and access records created while you use the service.
privacy.purpose: We use this information for account authentication, itinerary and community features, security and abuse prevention.
privacy.retention: We delete information promptly after account deletion or the purpose of processing ends, except where law requires retention.
privacy.sharing: We do not sell or share personal information except where required by law or with processors needed to provide the service.
privacy.rights: You may request access to, correction of or deletion of your personal information.

hero.title: Bring scattered travel plans together
hero.description: Organize flights, lodging, daily schedules, travel times, and bookings in one place and edit them with your companions. On the day, just open the plan and check things off.

features.title: Only what you need to prepare for a trip
features.description: Built to be the screen you actually open while traveling, not just another place to keep notes.

itinerary.title: Daily itineraries and travel times
itinerary.description: Arrange each day chronologically and total the time between stops to see whether you have enough breathing room.

booking.title: Prioritized booking checklist
booking.description: Keep tickets and admission passes ordered by priority, with booking links and status together on one card.

info.title: Expandable travel information
info.description: Keep frequently revisited details such as transit passes, currency, and packing lists in expandable sections.

share.title: Collaborator invites and public links
share.description: Invite companions by email to edit together, or share the itinerary through a read-only public link.

sync.title: Per-user checks and memo sync
sync.description: Checks and memos are saved to your account, so the same state follows you between phone and laptop.

print.title: Print the full itinerary
print.description: Lay out the full itinerary for printing so you can carry a paper copy.

steps.title: Ready in three steps
steps.description: Fill it in once, then keep using the same screen until the trip is over.

create.title: Create a trip
create.description: Enter a name, dates, and destinations to create a blank itinerary, or fill one instantly with the Osaka sample.

fill.title: Fill each day's itinerary
fill.description: Add flights, lodging, schedules, routes, and bookings. Drag to change their order.

check.title: Check things off as you travel
check.description: Mark completed plans and leave memos on the go. Companions viewing the same trip stay in sync.

showcase.title: Every check makes what's left clearer
showcase.description: Completed plans fade while progress fills up. This simplified example mirrors the actual screen.
